season.source: https://windingcreekcamp.org/campground-and-reservations/ ('Campsite and Cabin Rental ... Reservations 2026 Season: April 24 – October 11'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The camp's 'MAKE A RESERVATION' link goes to its Campspot page; all campers must also register and pay at the camp office before setting up. Campspot listed no site types on any date read 2026-10-13 (Oct 2026 - Jun 2027), so call (269) 945-5193 if nothing shows.

booking.source: https://windingcreekcamp.org/campground-and-reservations/ ('PLEASE READ ALL POLICIES AND GUIDELINES BEFORE BOOKING ONLINE'; 'MAKE A RESERVATION' -> Campspot; 'All campers must register and pay at the camp office prior to setting up camp') + https://www.campspot.com/book/windingcreekcamp (live booking page, 'Winding Creek Camp, a Winding Creek Camp Non-Profit Corporation', phone (269) 945-5193), read 2026-10-22

summary: Camp page (2026 season April 24 - October 11) still rents 'Trailer Site with Electricity $30.00' a night / $210 a week to the public alongside its cabins; no program enrolment is required, only registration at the camp office and the camp's conduct rules. Season and Campspot booking moved from derived to manual; fees, dump and store already sourced 2026-10-13 and unchanged. Amperage not stated by the camp. Seasonal lots exist ($1,200/yr) but their share is not published. Phone (269) 945-5193 matches. Note unchanged.
